---
title: "Poverty in the toy survey"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(boot)
survey <- read.csv("data/survey.csv")
share <- function(d, i) weighted.mean(d$welfare[i] < 3, d$weight[i])
interval <- boot.ci(boot(survey, share, R = 999), type = "perc")
```

The weighted headcount ratio is 0.346 in the toy survey, and the bootstrap gives its interval.

| Region | Headcount |
|---|---|
| North | 0.733 |
| South | 0.257 |
| East | 0.206 |
| West | 0.214 |
